1012.description: An overhead press with a band, twisting the torso as you press. It trains the shoulders and core.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place the band under your feet.
Hold the band handles at shoulder height with your palms facing forward.
Engage your core and press the band overhead, fully extending your arms.
As you press, twist your torso to one side, keeping your hips stable.
Pause for a moment at the top, then return to the starting position.
Repeat the press and twist on the opposite side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将弹力带放在脚下。
将弹力带手柄保持在与肩同高的位置，手掌朝前。
启动你的核心并将弹力带压过头顶，充分伸展你的手臂。
当你按压时，将你的躯干扭转到一侧，保持臀部稳定。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复按压和扭转。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

1076.description: A hamstring curl with heels in straps, alternating legs like running. It trains the hamstrings and core control.
instructions: Lie on your back with both heels in the straps and lift your hips.
Press your arms into the floor for balance.
Curl one heel toward your glutes while the other leg extends.
Switch legs in a smooth running rhythm.
Keep your hips high and level.
Continue for the set.

1140.description: You hold the straps and drive the knees like a sprinter, a quick leg and cardio move.
instructions: Hold the handles and lean slightly forward.
Stand on one leg with the other knee raised.
Drive one knee up as the opposite arm moves.
Switch legs with a quick hop.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Keep your core tight and pace steady.

1204.description: A single-arm pulldown on a high cable. It lets each side of the lats work on its own.
instructions: Attach a handle to a high pulley and sit facing the stack.
Grab the handle with one hand and sit tall.
Pull the handle down to the side of your chest, driving your elbow toward your hip.
Pause, then let your arm rise slowly.
Complete your reps and switch sides.

1268.description: A cable chest press on an exercise ball. It trains the chest and challenges balance.
instructions: Sit on an exercise ball with your feet flat on the ground and your knees at a 90-degree angle.
Hold the cable handles at chest height with your palms facing down and your elbows bent.
Engage your core and press the cable handles forward until your arms are fully extended.
Pause for a moment, then slowly release the tension and bring the cable handles back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，膝盖呈 90 度角。
将电缆手柄保持在胸部高度，手掌朝下，肘部弯曲。
收紧核心并向前按压缆索手柄，直到手臂完全伸展。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢释放张力，并将电缆手柄拉回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1332.description: Seated on a stability ball, you raise dumbbells one arm at a time. It trains the shoulders and upper back while your core keeps you balanced.
instructions: Sit on the stability ball with your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing inwards and your arms extended down by your sides.
Engage your core and slowly lift one arm up towards your shoulder, keeping your elbow slightly bent.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arm back down to the starting position.
Repeat the movement with the other arm.
Continue alternating arms for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在稳定球上，双脚平放在地面上，背部挺直。
双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝内，双臂在身体两侧向下伸展。
启动你的核心，慢慢地将一只手臂向肩膀抬起，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
用另一只手臂重复该动作。
继续交替手臂进行所需的重复次数。

1396.description: A smith machine toe raise where you rise onto the balls of your feet. It builds the calves and ankle strength.
instructions: Adjust the smith machine bar to a height that allows you to comfortably stand with your feet flat on the ground.
Position yourself under the bar with your shoulders directly below it and your feet shoulder-width apart.
Place the balls of your feet on a raised platform or weight plates, with your heels hanging off the edge.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and keep your back straight throughout the exercise.
Slowly raise your heels as high as possible, lifting your body weight onto the balls of your feet.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将史密斯机杆调整到一个高度，让您可以舒适地站立，双脚平放在地面上。
将自己置于杠铃下方，肩膀位于杠铃正下方，双脚分开与肩同宽。
将脚掌放在升高的平台或重量板上，脚后跟悬在边缘。
正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
在整个练习过程中启动你的核心并保持背部挺直。
慢慢地尽可能高地抬起脚后跟，将身体重量转移到脚掌上。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1460.description: Stepping forward into one lunge after another, moving across the room. It works the quads and glutes and challenges balance.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Take a step forward with your right leg, lowering your body into a lunge position.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee aligned with your ankle.
Push off with your right foot and bring your left foot forward, stepping into a lunge position with your left leg.
Continue alternating legs and walking forward, maintaining a controlled and steady pace.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
右腿向前迈出一步，将身体降低至弓步位置。
保持躯干直立，前膝与脚踝对齐。
右脚蹬地，左脚向前，左腿呈弓步姿势。
继续交替双腿向前行走，保持受控且稳定的步伐。
重复所需的重复次数。

1524.description: A snatch drill where you dip, drive and drop under a bar on your back into an overhead squat. It builds speed and overhead stability.
instructions: Rest the bar on your upper back and take a wide snatch grip.
Dip and drive up explosively, pushing the bar off your shoulders.
Drop quickly into a squat while pressing the bar overhead.
Catch it with locked arms over your mid-foot.
Stand up with control and return the bar to your back.

1588.description: A quick-footed drill where you hop side to side over a box. It builds agility, lower leg stamina and conditioning.
instructions: Stand next to a low box or step on one side.
Place the foot closest to it on top.
Hop across, landing the other foot on the box as the first foot goes down.
Keep your steps light and quick.
Continue shuffling side to side at a steady pace.

1652.description: A dumbbell curl on an exercise ball with one leg raised. It trains the biceps while testing balance.
instructions: Sit on an exercise ball with your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing forward and your arms fully extended.
Slowly curl the dumbbells towards your shoulders, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
While performing the bicep curl, raise one leg off the ground and hold it in the air for the duration of the exercise.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs and repeat.
instructionsZh: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，背部挺直。
每只手握住一个哑铃，手掌朝前，双臂完全伸展。
慢慢地将哑铃向肩膀弯曲，保持肘部靠近身体两侧。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
在进行二头肌弯举时，将一条腿抬离地面，并在整个练习过程中将其保持在空中。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿并重复。

1716.description: A seated chest stretch with help from a stability ball. It opens up the pectoralis major.
instructions: Sit on a stability ball with your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold a stability ball with both hands and extend your arms straight out in front of you.
Slowly lower the stability ball towards your chest, feeling a stretch in your pectoral muscles.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在稳定球上，双脚平放在地面上，背部挺直。
双手握住稳定球，并将双臂伸直至身前。
慢慢地将稳定球降低到胸部，感受胸肌的拉伸。
保持伸展几秒钟，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1780.description: Pressing a bent arm against a wall or frame stretches the chest and front shoulder. Changing the arm height shifts which part you feel.
instructions: Stand beside a wall or doorframe and place your forearm on it with your elbow bent to 90 degrees.
Step forward and turn your body away until you feel the stretch across your chest.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1844.description: Tilts the head back and to the side to stretch the front and side of the neck.
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders down.
Tilt your head back slightly.
Lower one ear toward the same shoulder.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1908.description: Stretches the back of the thigh with the toes lowered.
instructions: Stand with one heel on the floor in front of you.
Point your toes down.
Hinge forward from the hips with a flat back.
Keep the front leg nearly straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1972.description: A seated stretch that opens the front of the shoulders using a bench.
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench and place your hands behind you on it, fingers pointing back.
Walk your hips slightly forward off the bench.
Lower your hips gently until you feel a stretch at the front of the shoulders.
Keep your back close to the bench and shoulders down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then rise up.

2100.description: Stretches the front of the thigh from a seated position by folding one leg back while the other stays supported.
instructions: Sit sideways on a bench or sturdy seat with one leg hanging off the side.
Bend the hanging knee and bring the heel back toward your glutes.
Hold the foot or ankle with your hand and gently pull the heel closer.
Keep your torso upright and your knees close together.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release and switch legs.

2164.description: A side plank with a band around the legs to fire up the hips and the sides of the waist.
instructions: Place a band around your thighs and lie on one side with your legs straight.
Put your elbow under your shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line from head to feet.
Press your top leg gently up against the band.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

2292.description: A bent-over dumbbell raise to the sides. Trains the rear delts and upper back.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Raise your arms out to the sides, keeping a slight bend in your elbows, until they are parallel to the floor.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
将手臂向两侧举起，肘部保持轻微弯曲，直到与地板平行。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2420.description: A bicycle crunch with a band adding resistance to the leg movement.
instructions: Lie on your back with a band looped around your feet.
Hold the ends with your hands or place them by your head.
Lift your shoulders and bring your knees up.
Pedal your legs while twisting your elbow toward the opposite knee.
Keep your lower back flat.
Continue for the planned reps.

2612.description: Skipping over a rope at a steady pace. Classic cardio that builds endurance and coordination.
instructions: Hold the handles of the jump rope with your hands, palms facing inward.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Swing the rope over your head and jump over it as it comes towards your feet.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and repeat the jump as the rope comes around again.
Continue jumping for the desired duration or number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双手握住跳绳的手柄，掌心向内。
站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
将绳子甩过头顶，当绳子靠近你的脚时跳过它。
轻轻地用脚掌着地，当绳子再次绕回时重复跳跃。
继续跳跃所需的持续时间或重复次数。

2740.description: A beginner-friendly standing push-up against a wall with a wide hand position to emphasise the chest.
instructions: Stand facing a wall and place your hands on it, wider than your shoulders.
Step your feet back so your body leans in a straight line.
Bend your elbows to bring your chest toward the wall.
Push back to the start.
Keep your hips in line with your shoulders.

2804.description: A dumbbell squat with a hand on a support for balance. Lets you focus on a deep, steady squat pattern.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and rest the other hand on a stable support.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart and toes slightly out.
Sit your hips back and down until your thighs are about parallel.
Drive through your heels to stand, keeping your chest up.
Switch the dumbbell hand halfway through if needed.

2868.description: A seated Pilates twist that mobilises the spine and strengthens the obliques.
instructions: Sit tall with your legs extended and arms reaching out to the sides.
Flex your feet and grow tall through the crown of your head.
Twist your torso to one side, pulsing gently for a small extra turn.
Return to center without sagging in the chest.
Twist to the other side and repeat.

2932.description: A one-arm kettlebell press from a kneeling position. Kneeling takes the legs out of it and challenges your trunk.
instructions: Kneel on both knees with a kettlebell racked at your shoulder.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Press the kettlebell overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower it slowly back to your shoulder.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

2996.description: A one-arm overhead press against a band. It trains the shoulders and makes your core resist twisting.
instructions: Stand on the band with your feet hip width apart and hold the other end at shoulder height.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.
Press the hand straight overhead until your arm is almost straight.
Lower under control back to your shoulder.
Complete your reps without leaning sideways.
Switch arms and repeat.

3124.description: A seated chest press using a resistance band. Builds the chest, shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Sit on a chair or bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold the resistance band handles in each hand, with your palms facing down and elbows bent at a 90-degree angle.
Extend your arms forward, pushing the resistance band away from your chest.
Pause for a moment at the end of the movement, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在椅子或长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地面上。
每只手握住阻力带手柄，手掌朝下，肘部弯曲成 90 度角。
向前伸展双臂，将阻力带推离胸部。
动作结束时暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3188.description: A straight-arm pullover with weights hung from the dumbbell by a band. The swing makes your shoulders and trunk work harder.
instructions: Hang a weight from the dumbbell with a band.
Lie on a bench and hold it above your chest with straight arms.
Lower it in an arc behind your head.
Pull it back over your chest slowly.
Keep your ribs down and your core tight.
Use a light load to stay controlled.

3316.description: A flowing series of barbell lifts done back to back without putting the bar down. It works your whole body and your conditioning.
instructions: Load a light to moderate barbell and stand over it with feet hip width apart.
Perform the first lift of your chosen sequence, such as a deadlift.
Move straight into the next lift without setting the bar down.
Keep each rep crisp with a braced core and a flat back.
Finish all lifts for one round, then lower the bar and rest before repeating.

3380.description: Alternating or double low waves with heavy ropes that spike your heart rate and work the shoulders, arms and core.
instructions: Hold one rope end in each hand and stand in a quarter squat.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Whip the ropes down and up so waves travel low along the floor.
Keep the waves even and your hips stable.
Work for 20-30 seconds at a hard pace.
Rest, then repeat for several rounds.

3444.description: A step-up onto a sturdy chair, a simple single-leg exercise.
instructions: Face a sturdy chair.
Place one foot fully on the seat.
Drive through that heel to stand up.
Bring the other foot up.
Step down with control.
Do all reps on one leg, then switch.

3508.description: A seated leg curl with a band around the foot. It isolates the hamstrings.
instructions: Sit on the floor with a band anchored in front and looped around one foot.
Extend your leg with a slight tension on the band.
Curl your heel toward your glutes, pulling against the band.
Squeeze the hamstring briefly.
Return with control.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

3572.description: A standing overhead press with a kettlebell and no leg drive, focused on shoulder strength.
instructions: Hold the kettlebell at shoulder height in the rack position.
Stand tall with glutes and abs tight.
Press the bell straight overhead until your arm is locked out.
Lower it back to the shoulder under control.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

3636.description: A high-knee run in place with the hands on a wall for support. It raises the heart rate and trains the hip flexors.
instructions: Stand facing a wall with your feet hip-width apart.
Place your hands on the wall for support.
Engage your core and lift your right knee up towards your chest, while keeping your left foot on the ground.
Quickly switch legs, bringing your left knee up towards your chest and lowering your right foot back down.
Continue alternating legs in a running motion, bringing your knees up as high as possible.
Maintain a fast pace and keep your upper body stable throughout the exercise.
Repeat for the desired duration or number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 面向墙壁站立，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
将双手放在墙上以获得支撑。
启动你的核心并将右膝抬向胸部，同时将左脚保持在地面上。
快速换腿，将左膝抬向胸部，然后将右脚放低。
继续交替双腿进行跑步动作，将膝盖尽可能抬高。
在整个练习过程中保持快节奏并保持上半身稳定。
重复所需的持续时间或重复次数。

3700.description: An explosive jump where you pull your knees toward your chest in the air. It builds power and gets your heart rate up quickly.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and arms ready.
Dip into a quarter squat and swing your arms up.
Jump as high as you can and pull your knees toward your chest.
Land softly on the balls of your feet with bent knees.
Reset briefly and repeat.

3764.description: Curling from an incline bench stretches the biceps at the bottom for a deep contraction.
instructions: Sit back on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging.
Keep your shoulders against the bench.
Curl both dumbbells toward your shoulders.
Pause and squeeze.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.

3828.description: A row using a towel for resistance. It trains your back and arms with no equipment.
instructions: Hold a towel with both hands and stretch it taut.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Pull the towel toward your chest while pulling it apart.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly.

3892.description: A box jump that builds explosive power in the legs and hips.
instructions: Stand facing a plyo box with feet shoulder-width apart.
Swing your arms back and bend your knees.
Jump up and land softly on top of the box with both feet.
Stand fully upright at the top.
Step down carefully.
Reset and repeat.

3956.description: Step into a lunge with a twist to open the hips and loosen the trunk.
instructions: Stand tall.
Step forward into a lunge.
Twist your torso toward the front leg.
Return to centre and step back.
Alternate sides for 8-10 reps each.

4020.description: Lying leg raises with legs crossing over each other. It targets the lower abs and inner thighs.
instructions: Lie on your back with legs straight and raised.
Lower them slightly.
Cross one leg over the other.
Switch the cross.
Keep your lower back down.

4084.description: A band curl done with the band pulling horizontally, which keeps constant tension on your biceps through the whole range.
instructions: Anchor the band at chest height and face away from the anchor, holding the ends.
Step out until the band is taut and raise your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Bend your elbows to bring your hands toward your head.
Squeeze your biceps, then slowly extend your arms again.
Keep your elbows level with your shoulders the whole time.

4148.description: A second variation of the narrow grip high row using a band. It builds the upper back and rear shoulders.
instructions: Anchor the band high and grip it with hands close together.
Step back to create tension and stand tall.
Pull your hands toward your upper chest, elbows flaring slightly.
Pause and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Extend your arms slowly back to the start.
Keep your torso upright throughout.

4212.description: Balance on one leg while reaching the other foot toward points of an imaginary star. It builds stability, control and ankle strength.
instructions: Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Reach your free foot forward and tap lightly, then return.
Tap out to the side, then return.
Tap behind you, then return.
Keep your hips level and chest tall.
Switch legs after a set of taps.

4340.description: A pullover using a wider grip, which spreads the load across the lats and chest.
instructions: Lie on a bench with a barbell held wider than shoulder-width above your chest.
Keep your elbows slightly bent.
Lower the bar behind your head in a smooth arc.
Pull the bar back over your chest.
Maintain a stable core and avoid arching your back.

4404.description: A standing side stretch with your arms overhead that lengthens the sides of the body and opens the shoulders.
instructions: Stand tall with feet together and arms overhead, palms joined.
Reach up through your fingertips.
Lean gently to one side without twisting.
Breathe and hold for 15-20 seconds.
Return to center and repeat on the other side.

4468.description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the front of the thigh (rectus femoris). A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your front of the thigh (rectus femoris) while lying face down on the floor.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

4532.description: Swinging a kettlebell from between your legs to overhead in one motion. It builds power through the whole body.
instructions: Stand over the kettlebell and hinge to grip it with one hand.
Swing it back between your legs.
Drive your hips forward and pull the bell up close to your body.
Punch your hand through to catch it overhead with a straight arm.
Lower it back under control and repeat, then switch arms.

4596.description: A quick snapping front kick into a partner's pad that trains speed and leg control.
instructions: Face your partner, who holds a pad at body height.
Raise your knee quickly.
Snap your lower leg out to hit the pad with the ball of your foot.
Recoil right away to bend the knee again.
Keep your hands up.
Set your foot down and switch sides.

4724.description: A chin-up from a low bar while sitting in a squat, using your legs to share the work.
instructions: Set a low bar and grip it with palms facing you.
Sit into a deep squat beneath it.
Pull your chest to the bar.
Lower back down.
Use your legs as little as possible.

4788.description: A wide side-to-side squat on one leg at a time. It builds the thighs and mobilises the hips.
instructions: Stand with feet wide and toes slightly out.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee.
Keep the other leg straight with the foot flat or toes up.
Lower until your thigh is parallel.
Push back to the middle and alternate sides.

4852.description: Raising dumbbells out to the sides one arm at a time. It builds the side delts.
instructions: Stand holding light dumbbells at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise one arm out to shoulder height.
Lower it slowly.
Switch arms.

4916.description: A prone or quadruped move where you extend the leg backward. It focuses on the glutes.
instructions: Get on all fours with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Extend one leg back and up.
Squeeze the glute at the top.
Lower the leg without touching the floor.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

4980.description: Alternating small leg kicks while lying on your back with hands under your head. It works the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands under your head and legs extended.
Lift both heels a few inches off the floor and press your lower back down.
Kick one leg up higher while the other goes down, then switch in a steady rhythm.
Keep your legs fairly straight and your core tight.
Stop the set when your lower back starts to arch.

5044.description: Lying face down, you move from a W to a Y shape. It works the upper back and lower traps.
instructions: Lie face down in a W with elbows bent.
Lift your arms slightly off the floor.
Reach your arms forward and wide into a Y.
Pull back into the W with your shoulder blades squeezed.
Keep your neck relaxed and repeat.

5108.description: Squat down and swing a dumbbell diagonally across your body. It trains legs, trunk rotation and shoulders in one movement.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell with both hands by one hip.
Sit into a squat.
Stand up and swing the dumbbell diagonally across to overhead on the other side.
Rotate your torso and pivot your back foot as you go.
Return and repeat, then switch sides.

5172.description: A dynamic arm swing across the chest that warms up the pecs and shoulders.
instructions: Stand tall with your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Swing both arms forward and cross them in front of your chest.
Open them back out and squeeze your shoulder blades slightly.
Alternate which arm is on top.
Keep a steady, relaxed rhythm.

5236.description: A chin-up holding the arms bent at the top. It builds strength in the lats and biceps.
instructions: Hang from a bar with an underhand, shoulder-width grip.
Pull yourself up until your chin clears the bar.
Keep your elbows bent and your body still.
Hold briefly at the top.
Lower slowly until just short of straight arms.

5556.description: Push-up focusing on the slow lowering phase to build strength for full reps.
instructions: Start at the top of a push-up with straight arms.
Brace your core and keep a straight line.
Lower your chest to the floor over 3-5 seconds.
Drop to your knees or reset at the bottom.
Return to the top and repeat.

5684.description: A standing front kick with your arms crossed over your chest. Warms up the hips and legs while challenging balance.
instructions: Stand tall with your arms crossed over your chest.
Shift your weight onto one leg.
Kick the other leg forward to about hip height with control.
Lower it and repeat for your reps.
Switch legs and keep your torso upright.

5876.description: Lean into suspension straps and straighten your arms from a bent position. It trains the triceps using your body weight.
instructions: Hold the handles and lean forward with a straight body.
Start with your arms overhead and elbows bent.
Extend your arms, keeping your upper arms still.
Pause when your arms are straight.
Lower back slowly.

6068.description: Alternating curls with a bottle in each hand. It builds the biceps and keeps the pace easy.
instructions: Stand tall with a bottle in each hand, palms forward.
Curl one bottle toward your shoulder.
Lower it slowly as you curl the other.
Keep your elbows by your sides.
Avoid swinging your torso.

6516.description: A chest-supported row with a wide grip that shifts more work to the upper back and rear shoulders.
instructions: Lean your chest on the pad and take the wide handles.
Start with your arms extended.
Pull the handles back with your elbows flared out.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly and repeat.

6772.description: A standing stretch for the muscles on the outside of the lower leg. It helps ankle mobility.
instructions: Stand near a wall for balance.
Cross one foot behind and turn the sole so the outer edge presses into the floor.
Gently shift your weight onto that foot.
Feel the stretch along the outside of the lower leg.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch feet.

6964.description: A standing dumbbell press that adds upper back extension, training shoulder strength and posture together.
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and the dumbbells at shoulder height.
Brace your abs and lift your chest tall.
Press the dumbbells overhead while gently extending your upper back.
Keep your ribs down and avoid arching your lower back.
Lower to your shoulders with control.
Repeat for the planned reps.

7412.description: Combo lunge: step back, drive the knee up, then step forward into a lunge.
instructions: Stand tall with hands on hips.
Step back into a reverse lunge.
Drive that back leg forward into a high knee.
Step the same leg forward into a forward lunge.
Push back to standing and switch legs after your reps.

8052.description: A kneeling rotation that opens up the mid back. Good for loosening your upper spine before training or after sitting.
instructions: Kneel on all fours with your hands under your shoulders.
Place one hand behind your head.
Rotate your upper body and point that elbow toward the ceiling.
Follow your elbow with your eyes and keep your hips square.
Return and touch the elbow toward the opposite arm.
Do your reps, then switch sides.

10548.description: A one-legged calf raise performed slowly with full focus. It builds calf strength and ankle control.
instructions: Stand on one leg and hold a wall or rail lightly.
Lower your heel slightly for a stretch.
Rise high onto your toes, squeezing the calf.
Pause for a second at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

10676.description: Walking with a loaded backpack to add resistance. It builds leg endurance and trunk strength.
instructions: Put on a backpack and tighten the straps snug.
Stand tall with your shoulders back.
Walk at a steady pace on flat ground.
Take natural strides and breathe evenly.
Keep your core lightly braced.
Walk for 10-30 minutes depending on your fitness.

10740.description: A triceps stretch on the floor using a stick to deepen the stretch. It opens the back of your upper arm and shoulder.
instructions: Lie on your back holding a stick in both hands.
Bend one arm and take that hand behind your head.
Use the other hand to push the stick and press that elbow down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Switch arms.

10868.description: Squat standing on a Bosu ball. The unstable surface adds a balance challenge.
instructions: Stand on the Bosu with feet shoulder width apart.
Hold your arms forward.
Sit your hips back and bend your knees.
Keep your chest lifted.
Stand tall.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

10932.description: A towel stretch behind the back that opens the shoulder.
instructions: Hold a towel with one hand over your shoulder and the other behind your lower back.
Gently pull the towel upward with the lower hand.
Keep your chest open and neck relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

11060.description: A face pull that finishes with a rotation of the arms. It hits the rear shoulders and rotator cuff for healthy shoulders.
instructions: Set a rope at upper chest height and hold it with both hands, arms extended.
Pull the rope toward your face with elbows high.
At the end, rotate your fists upward so your hands finish above your elbows.
Squeeze your rear shoulders for a second.
Reverse the rotation and return slowly.

11252.description: A squat while holding a cable overhead. It trains the legs and challenges shoulder stability and core control.
instructions: Set a cable low and hold the handle overhead with straight arms, standing tall.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.
Squat down by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Keep the handle over your head and chest up.
Drive through your heels to stand.

11316.description: A half squat with your back sliding against a wall. It builds leg strength with support and good alignment.
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and your feet slightly forward.
Slide down until your knees are bent to about 45 degrees.
Keep your back flat on the wall.
Press through your heels to rise.
Repeat for the set.

11572.description: Lying over a foam roller, you gently arch the upper back to open up the thoracic spine.
instructions: Lie on your back with the roller under your upper back.
Support your head with your hands.
Keep your hips on the floor and knees bent.
Gently lean back over the roller.
Return to neutral and shift the roller up or down.
Move slowly and breathe out as you extend.

11764.description: A standing one-arm press with a palm-up grip that works the chest and tests core stability.
instructions: Set a cable at chest height and hold the handle with a palm-up grip.
Stand facing away in a staggered stance.
Press the handle forward until your arm is straight.
Keep your torso still and resist twisting.
Return slowly and switch arms after your reps.

0052.description: A hybrid between a close-grip bench press and a skull crusher. Heavily loads the triceps.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your back pressed against the bench.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lower the barbell to your chest, keeping your elbows tucked in close to your body.
Push the barbell back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，背部紧贴长凳。
正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
将杠铃降低到胸部，保持肘部靠近身体。
将杠铃推回到起始位置，完全伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

0116.description: A deadlift with nearly straight legs, which targets the hamstrings.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your toes pointing forward.
Hold the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Bend at your hips and lower the barbell towards the ground, keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent.
Lower the barbell until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Engage your hamstrings and glutes to lift the barbell back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，脚趾指向前方。
正手握住杠铃，双手分开略宽于肩宽。
弯曲臀部，将杠铃放低至地面，保持背部挺直，膝盖稍微弯曲。
降低杠铃，直到感觉到腿筋拉伸。
启动腿筋和臀肌，将杠铃举回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0180.description: Seated cable row from a low pulley. You pull the handles to your torso and squeeze the shoulder blades, building the mid back.
instructions: Sit on the machine with your feet flat on the footrests and your knees slightly bent.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip, palms facing down.
Keep your back straight and lean slightly forward, maintaining a slight bend in your elbows.
Pull the handles towards your body, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the peak of the movement, then slowly release the handles back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在机器上，双脚平放在脚踏板上，膝盖稍微弯曲。
正手握住手柄，手掌朝下。
保持背部挺直，稍微向前倾斜，肘部保持轻微弯曲。
将手柄拉向身体，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢松开手柄回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0244.description: A cable pull that rotates the torso as you pull the handle toward the body. It trains the lats and the core together.
instructions: Attach a cable handle to a low pulley and stand facing the machine.
Grasp the handle with your left hand and step away from the machine, extending your arm fully.
Position your feet shoulder-width apart, with your knees slightly bent.
Keep your back straight and your core engaged throughout the exercise.
Pull the handle towards your body, rotating your torso to the right as you do so.
Squeeze your back muscles at the end of the movement.
Slowly return to the starting position, keeping tension on the cable.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides and perform with your right hand.
instructionsZh: 将电缆手柄连接到低滑轮上并面向机器站立。
用左手抓住手柄，离开机器，完全伸展手臂。
双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
在整个练习过程中保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与其中。
将手柄拉向您的身体，同时将您的躯干向右旋转。
动作结束时挤压背部肌肉。
慢慢回到起始位置，保持绳索的张力。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边并用右手执行。

0308.description: The classic flat bench dumbbell fly. The arms open in an arc to stretch and squeeze the chest.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Extend your arms straight up over your chest, with a slight bend in your elbows.
Keeping a slight bend in your elbows, lower your arms out to the sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Pause for a moment, then reverse the movement and bring the dumbbells back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌相对。
将手臂伸直越过胸部，肘部稍微弯曲。
保持肘部轻微弯曲，将手臂以宽弧线向两侧放低，直到感觉到胸部有拉伸感。
暂停片刻，然后反转动作，将哑铃拉回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0372.description: You curl a dumbbell with the upper arm braced on a preacher pad. The pad stops swinging so the biceps do the work.
instructions: Sit on a preacher curl bench with your upper arms resting on the pad and your chest against it.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing up and your arms fully extended.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the dumbbells until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在牧师弯举凳上，上臂放在垫子上，胸部靠在垫子上。
每只手握住一个哑铃，手掌朝上，双臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0436.description: Lying on a bench, you lower dumbbells to your chest with elbows flared and press back up. It strongly targets the triceps.
instructions: Sit on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Raise the dumbbells to shoulder height, then rotate your wrists so that your palms are facing away from you.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms are fully extended, then lower them back down to shoulder height.
Rotate your wrists back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在平坦的长凳上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌相对。
将哑铃举至肩膀高度，然后旋转手腕，使手掌背向自己。
向上推哑铃，直到手臂完全伸展，然后将其放回至肩膀高度。
将手腕旋转回起始位置，然后重复所需的重复次数。

0500.description: Lying on your back, you hold your arms up and move them like windshield wipers. It works the chest, shoulders and core.
instructions: Start by lying flat on your back on a mat or bench.
Extend your arms straight out to the sides, perpendicular to your body.
Engage your core and lift both legs off the ground, keeping them together and straight.
Slowly lower your legs to one side, aiming to touch the ground with your feet while maintaining control.
Pause for a moment, then use your core to lift your legs back to the starting position.
Repeat the movement, this time lowering your legs to the opposite side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先平躺在垫子或长凳上。
将手臂伸直至两侧，与身体垂直。
启动你的核心并将双腿抬离地面，保持它们并拢并伸直。
慢慢地将双腿向一侧降低，目标是用脚接触地面，同时保持控制。
暂停片刻，然后用核心力量将双腿抬回到起始位置。
重复该动作，这次将双腿降低到另一侧。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

0564.description: A sideways jump onto a box that builds explosive power in the legs. It also trains landing control.
instructions: Stand beside a sturdy box or step.
Bend your knees and swing your arms back.
Jump up and sideways, landing with both feet on the box.
Land softly with bent knees and stand tall.
Step down carefully.
Repeat, then switch the side you start from.

0628.description: With a band around your ankles, you step sideways in a slight squat. Fires up the glutes and outer hips.
instructions: Place a resistance band around your ankles.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and slightly bend your knees.
Take a step to the side with your right foot, maintaining tension on the resistance band.
Follow with your left foot, stepping to the side to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
instructionsZh: 在脚踝周围放置一根阻力带。
双脚分开与肩同宽站立，稍微弯曲膝盖。
右脚向一侧迈出一步，保持阻力带的张力。
左脚跟随，向一侧迈步以返回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

0692.description: Sitting with one leg extended, you reach toward the foot. It stretches the back of the thigh.
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg straight and the other bent.
Keep your back long.
Hinge forward from the hips and reach toward your toes.
Stop when you feel a stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

0756.description: On the smith machine, you press your hips up with the bar across them. Works the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Position yourself on the smith machine with your back against the pad and your feet shoulder-width apart.
Place your hands on the barbell, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and glutes, then push through your heels to raise your hips off the ground.
Continue lifting until your body forms a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Hold for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将自己放在史密斯机上，背部靠在垫子上，双脚分开与肩同宽。
将双手放在杠铃上，距离略宽于肩宽。
启动你的核心肌群和臀大肌，然后通过脚后跟将臀部抬离地面。
继续提升，直到身体从膝盖到肩膀形成一条直线。
在顶部保持片刻，然后慢慢将臀部放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0820.description: A side bridge with a rotation of the top arm under your body. It challenges the obliques and shoulder stability.
instructions: Lie on your side and prop up on one forearm, feet stacked.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Reach your top arm under your torso, twisting slightly.
Return to the straight line.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

0884.description: A sideways step up under the smith bar. It works the quads and glutes one leg at a time.
instructions: Place a bench beside you and set the bar across your upper back.
Stand with the bench at your side.
Step up sideways with the near foot.
Straighten your leg to lift your body.
Lower slowly, finish reps, then switch sides.

0948.description: A relaxed, tall standing posture with arms by your sides. It is the neutral starting point for standing moves.
instructions: Stand with feet about hip-width apart and weight even on both feet.
Let your arms hang naturally at your sides.
Lengthen your spine and gently draw your ribs down.
Relax your shoulders and look straight ahead.
Breathe calmly for a few breaths.
